title: Running Commentary on Torah 10 — V'eleh ha'Mishpatim (Dances and Clapping)
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 10 — ואלה המשפטים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: Torah 10 opens with the same pasuk as Torah 7 — **"V'eleh ha'mishpatim asher tasim lifneihem v'chu'"** (Shemos 21:1) — but will develop it in a completely different direction: this is the Purim-Torah about **rekudim and hamcha'as kaf** (dances and clapping of hands) as the sweetening of dinim, Mordechai and Esther as yadayim and raglayim, and the tzaddik of the generation as the ruach that nullifies ga'avah.

intermediate.en: Same pasuk as Torah 7 — **"V'eleh ha'mishpatim asher tasim lifneihem"** (Shem 21:1) — but developed differently: Purim-Torah about **rekudim + hamcha'as kaf** as sweetening of dinim; Mordechai/Esther = yadayim/raglayim; tzaddik = ruach nullifying ga'avah.
intermediate.he: אותו פסוק של תורה ז' — **"ואלה המשפטים אשר תשים לפניהם"** (שמ' כא, א) — אך בכיוון שונה: תורת־פורים על **ריקודין ומחיאת כף** כהמתקת דינים; מרדכי/אסתר = ידיים/רגליים; הצדיק = רוח המבטל גאווה.

scholarly.he: אותו פסוק של תורה ז (שמ' כא, א), כיוון שונה: פורים, ריקודין ומחיאת כף, מרדכי/אסתר.

intermediate.en: **"א"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"א"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף א.

beginner.en: The entire first teaching in a single devastating line. **"When there are, chas v'shalom, **dinim** (judgments) on Israel — through **rekudim** (dances) and **hamcha'as kaf el kaf** (clapping hand to hand) is made the **hamtakas ha'dinim** (sweetening of the judgments)."** This is not metaphor. The Rebbe will demonstrate that clapping and dancing are **direct physical-spiritual operations** on the din-side of reality.

intermediate.en: **"When there are dinim on Israel — through **rekudim and hamcha'as kaf** is made the **hamtakas ha'dinim**."** Not metaphor — clapping and dancing are direct physical-spiritual operations on din.
intermediate.he: **"כשיש, ח"ו, דינים על ישראל — על־ידי **ריקודין ומחיאת כף** נעשה **המתקת הדינים**."** לא משל — מחיאת כף וריקוד הם פעולות פיזיות־רוחניות ישירות על הדין.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. "כשיש דינים ע"י רקודין ומחיאת כף נעשה המתקת הדינים."

intermediate.en: **"ב"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ב"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב.

beginner.en: **"The essence of the greatness of the Holy One blessed be He is that **even the nations** know that there is Elokim ruling and governing."** Source: Zohar Yisro 69b — **"When Yisro came and said **'ki atah yadati ki gadol Hashem'** (Shemos 18:11), **'kdein isyaker v'is'alah shma ila'ah'** — 'then the supernal Name was honored and elevated.'"** Hashem's name becomes *bigger* when a non-Jew who previously served his own idols recognizes His supremacy. The Torah's project isn't only Jewish piety; it is the expansion of Hashem's kingship into the field of the nations.

intermediate.en: **Essence of Hashem's greatness = even the nations know He rules.** Zohar Yisro 69b: when Yisro said **"ki atah yadati ki gadol Hashem"** (Shem 18:11), **"isyaker v'is'alah shma ila'ah"**. The Name becomes *bigger* when a non-Jew recognizes His supremacy.
intermediate.he: **עיקר גדולתו של הקב"ה — שגם האומות יודעים.** זוה"ק יתרו סט:: כשיתרו אמר **"כי עתה ידעתי כי גדול ה'"** (שמ' יח, יא), **"איקר ואתעלא שמא עילאה"**. השם "מתגדל" כשהגוי מכיר.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. עיקר גדולת ה' — שגם האומות יכירו. זוהר יתרו סט:.

intermediate.en: **"ג"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ג"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג.

beginner.en: **"But the nations — it is impossible for them to know Hashem's greatness except through the aspect of **Yaakov**"** — as it is written: **"'Beis Yaakov, lechu v'neilcha b'or Hashem'** (Yeshayahu 2:5). Yaakov revealed Hashem's Elokus more than the other avos — because **'Avraham called it **har** (mountain); Yitzchak called it **sadeh** (field)'** (Pesachim 88a). And **sadeh** is more *graspable* and more *needed for the world* than *har*. Yaakov called it **bayis** (house) — which is a settled place for people more than a field. Meaning: **Yaakov called the place of the Beis ha'Mikdash (which is the place of tefillah) a 'bayis'** — because he raised tefillah from *har* and *sadeh* to the aspect of **bayis**, which is graspable for people more than har and sadeh — because in the aspect of **bayis**, even the nations have some grasp of His Elokus, yisbarech Sh'mo.

intermediate.en: **Nations know Hashem only through Yaakov** ("beis Yaakov lechu v'neilcha," Yesh 2:5). **Avraham = har, Yitzchak = sadeh, Yaakov = bayis** (Pesachim 88a). *Sadeh* more graspable than *har*; *bayis* more than *sadeh*. Yaakov raised tefillah from har/sadeh to **bayis** — where even the nations have some grasp.
intermediate.he: **האומות מכירות ה' רק דרך יעקב** ("בית יעקב לכו ונלכה", יש' ב, ה). **אברהם = הר, יצחק = שדה, יעקב = בית** (פסחים פח.). *שדה* נתפס יותר מ*הר*; *בית* יותר מ*שדה*. יעקב העלה תפילה מהר/שדה ל**בית** — שבו יש גם לאומות תפיסה מסוימת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. האומות — דרך יעקב (יש' ב, ה; פסחים פח.: אברהם הר, יצחק שדה, יעקב בית). העלאת התפילה מהר/שדה לבית.

intermediate.en: **"ד"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ד"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד.

beginner.en: **"And this matter — to raise tefillah from the aspect of **har and sadeh** to the aspect of **bayis** (the aspect of 'Ir Elokeinu'), so that His Malchus be revealed also to the nations — is impossible to be done except through the **tzaddikei ha'dor**."** Chazal: **"'Mi sheyesh lo choleh b'soch beiso, yelech etzel chacham, vi'vakesh alav rachamim'"** (Bava Basra 116a) — 'one who has a sick person in his house, let him go to a chacham and request mercy for him.' **"For the essence of tefillah — only the tzaddikei ha'dor know."** Then the attack: **"There are **ba'alei ga'avah** who do not want people to go to tzaddikim, and they say that *they themselves* can pray, and they prevent others — when they have tza'ar or a sick person — from going to tzaddikim. Of them it is said: **'hashev eishes ha'ish... ki navi hu, v'yispalel ba'adcha'"** (Bereshis 20:7).

intermediate.en: **Raising tefillah from har/sadeh to bayis** requires tzaddikei hador: **"Mi sheyesh lo choleh... yelech etzel chacham"** (BB 116a). Only tzaddikei hador know the essence of tefillah. **Attack on ba'alei ga'avah** who block others from going to tzaddikim: **"hashev eishes ha'ish... v'yispalel ba'adcha"** (Ber 20:7).
intermediate.he: **להעלות תפילה מהר/שדה לבית** — רק ע"י צדיקי־הדור: **"מי שיש לו חולה... ילך אצל חכם"** (ב"ב קטז.). רק צדיקי הדור יודעים עיקר תפילה. **מתקפה על בעלי גאווה** החוסמים פנייה לצדיקים: **"השב אשת האיש... ויתפלל בעדך"** (בר' כ, ז).

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. העלאת התפילה ע"י צדיקי הדור (ב"ב קטז.). בעלי גאווה חוסמים פנייה לצדיק (בר' כ, ז).

beginner.en: The Rebbe turns sharp on the faster-without-tzaddik type. **"But these ba'alei ga'avah hold back Hashem's desire — for they do not ask tzaddikim to pray for them, because they think that they have fasted and afflicted themselves, and by this they are tzaddikim. But the truth is not so. For all the **ta'aniyos** (fasts) they have fasted are only like a **sack with many holes** — and when you empty the sack, nevertheless the holes remain."** Proof that the body is a sack: **"**'shinena, sheri sakach'** — 'sharp one, untie your sack' — said the Tanna (Shabbos 152a)."** **"If they would look at themselves truthfully, after all the ta'aniyos they would see all their ta'avos still tied into their sack — i.e., their body. And not only their own ta'avos — but also their **father's ta'avos** that were with them **from the moment of conception**, because their father did not sanctify himself at that moment."** Fasting without a tzaddik is emptying a sack full of holes: nothing stays emptied.

intermediate.en: **Ba'alei ga'avah who fast without a tzaddik** = emptying a sack of holes (Shabbos 152a: "shinena, sheri sakach" — body as sack). Post-fast, ta'avos still tied in — including **father's ta'avos** from an unsanctified moment of conception.
intermediate.he: **בעלי גאווה המתענים בלי צדיק** = ריקון שק מחורר (שבת קנב.: "שיננא, שרי שקך" — הגוף שק). אחרי התענית, התאוות קשורות — גם **תאוות האב** מרגע ההורות שלא התקדש.

scholarly.he: בעלי־גאווה שמתענים בלי צדיק — שק מחורר (שבת קנב.). תאוות האב מההורות שלא התקדשה.

beginner.en: **"And this is the peirush: **'Vayomer lahem Yaakov avihem: osi shikaltem, Yosef einenu'** (Bereshis 42:36) — 'Yaakov their father said to them: you have bereaved me; Yosef is not.' This is a hint to the **tochachas ha'sechel** — the rebuke of the intellect to the ba'alei ga'avah."** **"Yaakov is the aspect of **sechel** — as Onkelos translates (Bereshis 27:36): **'vayak'veni'** as **'v'chakmani'** ('he outsmarted me'). And: **'avihem'** — **'av b'chochmah'** (Megillah 13a). The sechel rebukes them: **'osi shikaltem'** — because **'kol hamisga'eh, chochmaso mistaleket mimenu'** (Pesachim 66b) — 'whoever becomes proud, his wisdom departs from him.'"** **"'Yosef einenu' — this is the aspect of **tikkun ha'me'us** — you have not yet repaired the disgrace and contempt — for the tikkun ha'me'us is the aspect of Yosef — on the name: **'asaf Elokim es cherpasi'** (Bereshis 30:23)."**

intermediate.en: **"Osi shikaltem, Yosef einenu"** (Ber 42:36) = rebuke-of-sechel to ba'alei ga'avah. **Yaakov = sechel** (Targum "vayak'veni" → "v'chakmani," Ber 27:36); **avihem** = **"av b'chochmah"** (Meg 13a). Rebuke: **"kol hamisga'eh, chochmaso mistaleket"** (Pes 66b). **"Yosef einenu"** = tikkun ha'me'us still undone (Yosef = **"asaf Elokim es cherpasi,"** Ber 30:23).
intermediate.he: **"אותי שיכלתם, יוסף איננו"** (בר' מב, לו) = תוכחת־השכל לבעלי־גאווה. **יעקב = שכל** (ת"א "ויעקבני" → "וחכמני", בר' כז, לו); **אביהם** = **"אב בחכמה"** (מג' יג.). התוכחה: **"כל המתגאה, חכמתו מסתלקת ממנו"** (פס' סו:). **"יוסף איננו"** = תיקון המאוס לא נעשה (יוסף = **"אסף אלקים את חרפתי"**, בר' ל, כג).

scholarly.he: "אותי שיכלתם, יוסף איננו" (בר' מב, לו): יעקב=שכל (ת"א; מג' יג.); מתגאה—חכמתו מסתלקת (פס' סו:); יוסף—תיקון המאוס (בר' ל, כג).

beginner.en: **"ה."** **"The **eitzah ha'ye'utzah** (advised counsel) to nullify **ga'avah — which is avodah zarah** — as it is written: **'to'avas Hashem kol gvah lev'** (Mishlei 16:5) (as Chazal expounded Sotah 4b) — **the main way is through hiskarvus l'tzaddikim**."** Source from Tikkunim (tikkun 21, 48b): **"'bi'teru'ah d'ihu rucha, is'avir el acher'** — 'with **teru'ah** (the shofar-blast) which is **ruach**, the **el acher** (strange god) is nullified.'"** **"And tzaddik is the aspect of **rucha**, as it is written: **'ish asher ruach bo'** (Bamidbar 27:18) — and through him is subdued **ruach gevoha** (the high spirit), **el acher** — and from **acher** is made **echad** (**אחר → אחד**), because he is the **kotza d'os daled** (the thorn of the letter dalet) (Tikkun 21, 55b) — from which are the four ruchos, as it is written: **'me'arba ruchos bo'i ha'ruach'** (Yechezkel 37:9)."** **"And this language of **teru'ah** is lashon of **'tero'em b'shevet barzel'** (Tehillim 2:9) — breaking them."**

intermediate.en: **Eitzah against ga'avah-as-AZ** ("to'avas Hashem kol gvah lev," Mishlei 16:5; Sotah 4b) = **hiskarvus l'tzaddikim**. Tikkun 21 48b: **teru'ah = ruach; through ruach, el acher is nullified**. Tzaddik = ruach ("ish asher ruach bo," Bam 27:18). **אחר → אחד** by adding the **kotza d'os ד** (Tikkun 21 55b), from which arise 4 ruchos ("me'arba ruchos bo'i ha'ruach," Yech 37:9). **Teru'ah** also = **"tero'em b'shevet barzel"** (Teh 2:9) — breaking.
intermediate.he: **עצה נגד גאווה־כ־ע"ז** ("תועבת ה' כל גבה לב", מש' טז, ה; סוטה ד:) = **התקרבות לצדיקים**. תיקון כא מח:: **תרועה = רוח; ברוח אל־אחר מתבטל**. צדיק = רוח ("איש אשר רוח בו", במ' כז, יח). **אחר → אחד** ע"י תוספת **קוצא דאות ד** (תיקון כא נה:), שממנה ד' רוחות ("מארבע רוחות בואי הרוח", יחז' לז, ט). **תרועה** גם = **"תרועם בשבט ברזל"** (תה' ב, ט) — שבירה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. עצה נגד גאווה=ע"ז (מש' טז, ה; סוטה ד:) — התקרבות לצדיקים. תיקון כא מח: (תרועה=רוח→אל־אחר בטל); אחר→אחד ע"י קוצא דאות ד (תיקון כא נה:; יחז' לז, ט).

intermediate.en: **"ו"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ו"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו.

beginner.en: Now the heart of Purim. **"This is the aspect of **rekudin and hamcha'as kaf** — because rekudin and hamcha'as kaf are drawn from the aspect of the **ruach in the lev** (spirit in the heart) — as can be seen empirically: through joy of the heart one dances and claps hand to hand."** **"As brought in the Tikkunim (tikkun 21, 51b): **'v'hai rucha nashiv b'shis prakin d'd'ra'a u'v'shis prakin d'shokin'** — 'and this ruach blows through the six joints of the arm and the six joints of the leg' — and this is the aspect of hamcha'as kaf and the aspect of rekudin."** And: **"'Libo nasah es raglav'** (Bereishis Rabbah, Vayetze, 70:8) — 'his heart lifted his legs' — by means of the ruach in the heart come the dancing; i.e., through the tzaddik (who is the aspect of ruach), ga'avah is nullified — as it is written: **'al tevoeni regel ga'avah'** (Tehillim 36:12) — and avodah zarah is nullified, as it is written: **'v'rachatzu ragleichem'** (Bereshis 18:4)."**

intermediate.en: **Rekudin + hamcha'as kaf = drawn from ruach in the lev.** Tikkun 21 51b: **"v'hai rucha nashiv b'shis prakin d'd'ra'a u'v'shis prakin d'shokin"** — 12 joints = kaf+regel. **"Libo nasah es raglav"** (BR Vayetze 70:8): ruach of heart drives dance. Tzaddik = ruach → nullifies **regel ga'avah** (Teh 36:12) and AZ (**"v'rachatzu ragleichem,"** Ber 18:4).
intermediate.he: **ריקודין + מחיאת כף = נמשכים מרוח שבלב.** תיקון כא נא:: **"והאי רוחא נשיב בשית פרקין דדרועא ובשית פרקין דשוקין"** — י"ב פרקים = כף+רגל. **"ליבו נשא את רגליו"** (ב"ר ויצא ע, ח): רוח הלב מניעה ריקוד. צדיק = רוח → מבטל **רגל גאווה** (תה' לו, יב) וע"ז (**"ורחצו רגליכם,"** בר' יח, ד).

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. ריקוד ומחיאת־כף נמשכים מרוח הלב (תיקון כא נא:: י"ב פרקי כף+רגל). "לבו נשא את רגליו" (ב"ר ויצא ע, ח). ביטול רגל־גאווה (תה' לו, יב) וע"ז (בר' יח, ד).

intermediate.en: **"ז"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ז"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז.

beginner.en: **"And the Torah is also the aspect of **yadayim v'raglayim**, because there is in the Torah **nigleh v'nistar**."** **"**Nigleh** is the aspect of **yadayim** — as it is written: **'dodi shalach yado min ha'chor'** (Shir HaShirim 5:4) — '**min ha'chor**' = **'charus al ha'luchos'** (Shemos 32:16 — 'engraved upon the tablets') — which is in nigleh."** **"And **nistar** is the aspect of **raglayim**, as Chazal said (Sukkah 49b): **'chamuki yerechaich'** — 'the curves of your thighs' (Shir 7:2) — **'mah yerech b'seter'** — as the thigh is hidden — etc."** **"And the totality of the Torah is called **lev** — which begins with **beis** and ends with **lamed** (ב...ל = lev) — for there is the **mishkan ha'rucha** that blows through the six joints of the arm and the six joints of the legs — i.e., through **nigleh v'nistar**."**

intermediate.en: **Torah = yadayim + raglayim** (nigleh + nistar). Nigleh = yadayim (**"dodi shalach yado min ha'chor,"** Shir 5:4; chor = **charus** on the luchos, Shem 32:16). Nistar = raglayim (**"chamuki yerechaich,"** Shir 7:2; Sukkah 49b: "mah yerech b'seter"). Totality = **lev** (בית→למד); the ruach blows through 12 joints = nigleh+nistar.
intermediate.he: **תורה = ידיים + רגליים** (נגלה + נסתר). נגלה = ידיים (**"דודי שלח ידו מן החור",** שה"ש ה, ד; חור = **חרות** על הלוחות, שמ' לב, טז). נסתר = רגליים (**"חמוקי ירכייך",** שה"ש ז, ב; סוכה מט:: "מה ירך בסתר"). כללות = **לב** (ב→ל); הרוח נשיב ב־12 פרקים = נגלה+נסתר.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. תורה = יד+רגל = נגלה+נסתר (שה"ש ה, ד — חרות על הלוחות; ז, ב; סוכה מט:: "מה ירך בסתר"). כללות = לב (ב→ל).

intermediate.en: **"ח"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ח"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ח.

beginner.en: **"And this is the aspect of **Mordechai, Esther, and Haman** — aspects of Purim — aspect of the **goral** that Haman cast, aspect of the **omer seorim** (barley-offering)."** **"Haman is the aspect of **avodah zarah** — as Chazal said (Megillah 10b) that he made himself into avodah zarah. Therefore he cast **pur, which is the goral**, in the month that Moshe died (ibid. 13b) — because **Moshe nullifies avodah zarah** — and for this Moshe was **buried opposite Beis Pe'or**, to nullify the avodah zarah at Pe'or (Sotah 14a — see Tosfos there). For **Moshe = gematria **charon af** (as brought in Megaleh Amukos, ofan 137) — he nullifies the **charon af** of avodah zarah — because he received the Torah, which is the aspect of **yadayim v'raglayim** as above."**

intermediate.en: **Mordechai + Esther + Haman = Purim structure.** Haman = avodah zarah (Meg 10b: "made himself AZ"). Cast **pur** in month Moshe died (13b); **Moshe nullifies AZ** — buried opposite Pe'or (Sotah 14a). **Moshe = gematria **charon af** (Megaleh Amukos 137) — nullifies the charon af of AZ. Moshe received Torah = yadayim+raglayim.
intermediate.he: **מרדכי + אסתר + המן = מבנה פורים.** המן = ע"ז (מג' י:: "עשה עצמו ע"ז"). הפיל **פור** בחודש שמת משה (יג:); **משה מבטל ע"ז** — נקבר מול פעור (סוטה יד.). **משה = גימטריה **חרון אף** (מגלה עמוקות, אופן קלז) — מבטל חרון־אף של ע"ז. משה קיבל תורה = ידיים+רגליים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. המן=ע"ז (מג' י:); פור בחודש מיתת משה (מג' יג:); משה מבטל ע"ז (סוטה יד.); משה גימ' חרון אף (מגלה עמוקות קלז).

beginner.en: **"But Mordechai and Esther had the power to nullify Haman's avodah zarah — and for this, in their days **Israel received the Torah anew** — as Chazal said (Shabbos 88a): **'kimu v'kiblu — kimu mah she'kiblu kvar'** — 'they established and accepted — they established what they had already accepted.'"** **"And this: **'kimu v'kiblu'** — **'kimu'** is the aspect of **raglayim**, and **'kiblu'** is the aspect of **yadayim** — and this is the aspect of the Torah itself, as above."** **"And this is the aspect of Mordechai and Esther: **'Mordechai = mar dror'"** (Chullin 139b). **"'Dror' = lashon **cheirus** (freedom) — this is the aspect of **yadayim** — as it is written: **'dodi shalach yado min ha'chor'** as above. And Esther is the aspect of **shokayim** — **'mah yerech b'seter'** as above."** **"And this is the lashon of **Purim** — i.e., the nullification of avodah zarah — as it is written: **'purah darachti l'vadi'** (Yeshayahu 63:3) — 'I have trodden the winepress alone.'"**

intermediate.en: **Mordechai + Esther nullified Haman's AZ** → Israel received Torah anew (Shab 88a: **"kimu v'kiblu"** = "kimu mah she'kiblu kvar"). **Kimu = raglayim; kiblu = yadayim** = Torah itself. **Mordechai = mar dror** (Chullin 139b); **dror = cheirus = yadayim** ("dodi shalach yado min ha'chor"). **Esther = shokayim** ("mah yerech b'seter"). **Purim** = **"purah darachti"** (Yesh 63:3) — treading = nullification of AZ.
intermediate.he: **מרדכי + אסתר ביטלו ע"ז של המן** → קיבלו תורה מחדש (שבת פח.: **"קיימו וקיבלו"** = "קיימו מה שקיבלו כבר"). **קיימו = רגליים; קיבלו = ידיים** = התורה עצמה. **מרדכי = מר דרור** (חולין קלט:); **דרור = חירות = ידיים** ("דודי שלח ידו מן החור"). **אסתר = שוקיים** ("מה ירך בסתר"). **פורים** = **"פורה דרכתי"** (יש' סג, ג) — דריכה = ביטול ע"ז.

scholarly.he: מרדכי (=מר דרור, חולין קלט:) ואסתר ביטלו ע"ז של המן; קבלת התורה מחדש (שבת פח.: "קיימו וקיבלו"). קיימו=רגל; קיבלו=יד. פורים="פורה דרכתי" (יש' סג, ג).

intermediate.en: **"ט"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ט"** כותרת.

scholarly.he: סעיף ט.

beginner.en: Eighth Rabba bar bar Chana ma'amar. **"Amar Rabba bar bar Chana: said to me a certain Arab: 'Come, I will show you **blu'ei d'Korach** (those swallowed of Korach).' I went and saw two cracks emitting smoke. He took a **gabba d'amra** (piece of wool), dipped it in water, placed it on the tip of his spear, and inserted it there. When he pulled it out, it came out singed. He said to me: 'Listen! what do you hear?' And I heard them saying: **'Moshe emes v'toraso emes, v'hein bada'in'** — 'Moshe is true and his Torah is true, and we are liars.' He said to me: 'Every 30 days Gehinnom returns them here like meat in a pot, and they say thus: Moshe and his Torah are true, and we are liars.'"** (Bava Basra 74a).

intermediate.en: Eighth ma'amar: Arab shows **blu'ei d'Korach**. Two smoking cracks. Took **gabba d'amra** dipped in water on spear tip, inserted — came out singed. Listened: **"Moshe emes v'toraso emes, v'hein bada'in."** Every 30 days Gehinnom returns them like meat in a pot (Bava Basra 74a).
intermediate.he: המאמר השמיני: הטייעא מראה **בלועי דקרח**. שני בזעי מעלים עשן. שקל **גבבא דעמרא** משויה במיא על ריש רומחא והחדירה — יצאה חרוכה. שמע: **"משה אמת ותורתו אמת, והן בדאין."** כל שלושים יום גיהנום מחזירם כבשר בקלחת (ב"ב עד.).

scholarly.he: ב"ב עד.: המאמר השמיני — בלועי דקרח, בזעי/קטרא, גבבא דעמרא/במיא/רומחא/אחרך, "משה אמת ותורתו אמת והן בדאין".

beginner.en: **Rashbam's gloss:** **baz'ei** = cracks, as it is written: 'va'tibaka ha'adamah' (Bamidbar 16:31); **kitra** = smoke; **shakil gabba d'amra** = took wool-fleece and steeped it in water; **acharech acharuchei** = these fleeces [came out burnt], even though he had soaked them in water; **atzis** = listen; **u'sh'ma'as dekaamrei** = for indeed they went down alive to She'ol; **kol tlasin yomin** = every Rosh Chodesh; **b'kalachas** = like they turn a pot over so the [food] is cooked.

intermediate.en: Rashbam: **baz'ei** = cracks ("va'tibaka ha'adamah," Bam 16:31); **kitra** = smoke; **gabba d'amra** = wool-fleece soaked in water; **acharech** = burnt (despite soaking); **atzis** = listen; **kol tlasin yomin** = every R"Ch; **b'kalachas** = turned like food in a pot.
intermediate.he: רשב"ם: **בזעי** = בקעים ("ותבקע האדמה", במ' טז, לא); **קטרא** = עשן; **גבבא דעמרא** = גזת צמר שרויה במים; **אחרך** = חרוך (למרות הטבילה); **אצית** = שמע; **כל תלתין יומין** = כל ר"ח; **בקלחת** = הפיכה כקדירה.

scholarly.he: רשב"ם: בזעי=בקעים (במ' טז, לא); קטרא=עשן; גבבא דעמרא=גזת צמר; אחרך=חרוך; אצית=שמע; תלתין יומין=ר"ח; קלחת=קדירה.

beginner.en: The Rebbe's decoding. **"'Blu'ei d'Korach'** — as brought in the Midrash (Bamidbar Rabbah 18; Yerushalmi Sanhedrin perek Chelek): **'Korach min hayah'** — Korach was a heretic — the aspect of **avodah zarah, minus**."** **"'V'chazai trei baz'ei d'havu nafik minayhu kitra'** — this is the aspect of **charon af** caused by **minus** — as Chazal said: **'kol zman she'avodah zarah ba'olam, charon af ba'olam.'** And **'trei baz'ei'** is the aspect of the **two openings of the nostrils** from which smoke issues — as it is written: **'alah ashan b'apo'** (Tehillim 18:9)."** **"'V'shakil gabba d'amra'** — this is the aspect of **omer** (the Purim omer-seorim), as above. **'U'mashyei b'maya'** — this is the aspect of **seorim** (barley) — the aspect of **Esther via ruach ha'kodesh** — which is the aspect of **raglayim** as above. Because **raglayim are afikei mayim** (channels of water)."** The entire Korach-ma'amar is a recoded Purim-teaching: Korach's minus generates the charon-af-smoke from both nostrils; the wool dipped in water = the omer-seorim (= Esther/raglayim) placed on a spear (= Mordechai/yadayim) — Purim-structures inserted into Gehinnom's cracks to make the heretics themselves confess: *Moshe is true, his Torah is true, we are liars.*

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **Blu'ei d'Korach** = heretics ("Korach min hayah," BaMR 18; Yerushalmi Sanh Chelek) = **AZ/minus**. **Trei baz'ei with kitra** = **two nostrils** emitting smoke = charon af of minus ("alah ashan b'apo," Teh 18:9). **Gabba d'amra b'maya on the spear** = **omer + seorim** (Esther's ruach hakodesh / raglayim, since raglayim are afikei mayim) placed on **spear** (Mordechai / yadayim). The Purim-structure inserted into Gehinnom makes heretics confess: **"Moshe true, Torah true, we are liars."**
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **בלועי דקרח** = מינים ("קרח מין היה", במד"ר יח; יר' סנה' פרק חלק) = **ע"ז/מינות**. **תרי בזעי עם קטרא** = **שני נקבי־האף** מעלים עשן = חרון־אף של מינות ("עלה עשן באפו", תה' יח, ט). **גבבא דעמרא במיא על הרומח** = **עומר + שעורים** (רוח־הקודש של אסתר / רגליים — שרגליים אפיקי מים) על **רומח** (מרדכי / ידיים). מבנה פורים המוחדר לגיהנום מאלץ את המינים להודות: **"משה אמת, תורתו אמת, והן בדאין."**

scholarly.he: פירוש: בלועי דקרח=מינים (במד"ר יח; יר' סנה'); בזעי=נקבי אף (תה' יח, ט); גבבא דעמרא/במיא=עומר+שעורים=אסתר/רגליים (אפיקי מים); רומחא=מרדכי/ידיים. מבנה־פורים בגיהנום.

beginner.en: **"י."** The peirush pasuk. **"'V'eleh ha'mishpatim asher tasim lifneihem.'** In the Mekhilta: **'asher tasim lifneihem — hishvu ishah l'ish l'chol dinim sheba'Torah'** — 'they equated woman to man for all judgments in the Torah.' **Peirush**: for all dinim in the Torah that need sweetening, one must **hashva'ah** — i.e., **yichud**: **Kudsha Brich Hu u'Shchintei** — which is the aspect of **ishah v'ish — aspect of Mordechai and Esther**. And: **'v'eleh'** — 'every place where *v'eleh* is said, it **adds** on the previous things' (Bereishis Rabbah, Noach 30) — the aspect of **tosefes, ribui — aspect of ga'avah, avodah zarah** — as it is written: **'lo me'rubchem chashak Hashem'** (Devarim 7:7) — peirush: ga'avah (see Rashi and Chullin 89a). And this is the aspect of 'mosif al ha'rishonim' — which is the aspect of **Haman-Amalek**."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush pasuk**: **"V'eleh ha'mishpatim asher tasim lifneihem"** — Mekhilta: **"hishvu ishah l'ish l'chol dinim sheba'Torah."** Every din needing sweetening = **hashva'ah = yichud Kudsha Brich Hu u'Shchintei = ishah v'ish = Mordechai/Esther**. **V'eleh** (mosif al ha'rishonim, BR Noach 30) = tosefes/ribui = **ga'avah = AZ** ("lo me'rubchem chashak Hashem," Dev 7:7 = ga'avah; Rashi; Chullin 89a) = **Haman-Amalek**.
intermediate.he: **פירוש הפסוק**: **"ואלה המשפטים אשר תשים לפניהם"** — מכילתא: **"השוו אשה לאיש לכל דינים שבתורה."** כל דין הצריך המתקה = **השוואה = ייחוד קוב"ה ושכינתיה = אשה ואיש = מרדכי/אסתר**. **ואלה** (מוסיף על הראשונים, ב"ר נח ל) = תוספת/ריבוי = **גאווה = ע"ז** ("לא מרובכם חשק ה'", דב' ז, ז = גאווה; רש"י; חולין פט.) = **המן־עמלק**.

scholarly.he: סעיף י. פירוש הפסוק: "השוו אשה לאיש" (מכילתא) = ייחוד קוב"ה ושכינתיה = מרדכי ואסתר. "ואלה" (מוסיף, ב"ר נח ל) = תוספת/גאווה/ע"ז (דב' ז, ז; חולין פט.) = המן־עמלק.

beginner.en: **"And behold, from all these matters you understand that **nigleh = yadayim, nistar = raglayim** — the aspect of Mordechai and Esther. And although **nistar is higher than nigleh**, nevertheless the **revelation of nigleh** is in the higher place (yadayim), and the **nistar** is in the raglayim (which is below the yadayim). And the matter is deep — but it is the matter written in the Zohar: **Tannaim in the shokayim, and Amoraim in the yadayim**. And although Tannaim are higher than Amoraim, nevertheless they are in a place that is below the place of the Amoraim. And likewise Nevi'im and Kesuvim. And the resolution of this is already explained (see the commentary printed at the end of the Tikkunim, p. 10, where this matter is explained)."**

intermediate.en: **Recap**: **nigleh=yadayim, nistar=raglayim = Mordechai/Esther**. Though nistar > nigleh, nigleh's revelation is in the higher place (yadayim), nistar in the lower (raglayim). Zohar: **Tannaim in shokayim, Amoraim in yadayim** (though Tannaim > Amoraim). Same for Nevi'im/Kesuvim. Tosfos Tikkunim p. 10.
intermediate.he: **סיכום**: **נגלה=ידיים, נסתר=רגליים = מרדכי/אסתר**. אף שנסתר > נגלה, התגלות הנגלה במקום הגבוה (ידיים), הנסתר בנמוך (רגליים). זוהר: **תנאים בשוקיים, אמוראים בידיים** (אף שתנאים > אמוראים). כך נביאים/כתובים. עיין פירוש תיקונים דף י.

scholarly.he: סיכום: נגלה=יד, נסתר=רגל; מרדכי/אסתר. זוה"ק: תנאים בשוקיים, אמוראים בידיים (תיקונים דף י).

beginner.en: **"(Moreover, I saw this in a handwriting of our Rebbe, of blessed memory, himself, regarding the above Torah — and this is what it says:)"** Reb Nosson's editorial bracket: what follows is recorded in Rabbeinu's own handwriting.

intermediate.en: Reb Nosson: **"I saw this in Rabbeinu's own handwriting regarding the above Torah — and this is what it says:"** Following is Rabbeinu's own hand.
intermediate.he: הערת ר' נתן: **"עוד ראה זה מצאתי מכתב יד רבנו, זכרונו לברכה, בעצמו מענין התורה הנ"ל, וזהו:"** הבא בכתב־יד הרבי עצמו.

scholarly.he: הערת ר' נתן: נמצא מכת"י הרבי.

beginner.en: **"'V'eleh ha'mishpatim asher tasim' — **ga'avah** — it is known in all the earth that it is a disgraceful middah and one must flee from it, but there are people who pursue kavod and want to rule and lead the world, and they say they have the power to make pidyonos and pray tefillos; of them it is said: **'hashev eishes ha'ish ki navi hu, v'yispalel ba'adcha v'chi'yeh'** (Bereshis 20:7). For this is known, that the Holy One Blessed be He [desires the tefillos of tzaddikim, and one must go to them that they pray over one]. But **ba'alei ga'avah do not go to tzaddikim to ask them to pray over them, and also do not allow others to go to tzaddikim to pray for them, for they say..."** The Torah ends mid-sentence, Rabbeinu's own voice cut off — leaving the reader holding the unfinished indictment of the ba'al ga'avah who blocks the community's access to the tzaddik.

intermediate.en: **Rabbeinu's hand continuing**: "**Ga'avah** — known as disgraceful, yet some pursue kavod, claim they can do pidyonos and tefillos. Of them: **"hashev eishes ha'ish ki navi hu, v'yispalel ba'adcha"** (Ber 20:7). Hashem [desires the tefillos of tzaddikim — go to them]. But ba'alei ga'avah don't go to tzaddikim and don't let others go, for they say..." Ends mid-sentence — leaving the reader holding the unfinished indictment.
intermediate.he: **המשך בכת"י הרבי**: "**גאווה** — ידועה כמידה מגונה, ומ"מ יש רודפי־כבוד הטוענים שיכולים לעשות פדיונות ותפילות. עליהם: **"השב אשת האיש כי נביא הוא ויתפלל בעדך"** (בר' כ, ז). ה' [חפץ בתפילת צדיקים — לילך אליהם]. אך בעלי־גאווה אינם הולכים לצדיקים ואינם מניחים לאחרים ללכת, כי אומרים..." ההפסקה באמצע משפט — משאירה את הקורא עם הקטרוג הלא־גמור.

scholarly.he: מכתי"ק רבנו: גאווה, "השב אשת האיש" (בר' כ, ז) — הקב"ה חפץ בתפילת צדיקים; בעלי־גאווה חוסמים. נקטע באמצע.
